The *Uttiyattheraapadāna* (Tha Ap 30) is a verse biographical narrative preserved within the *Therāpadāna* section of the Pali canon [SuttaCentral]. It relates the past merits and religious career of the elder (thera) Uttiya. SuttaCentral records five modern translations of the text in five languages, although no specific English title is registered [SuttaCentral].

In addition, formulaic verses and expressions are shared with numerous other Apadāna poems, including the *Subhūtittheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 23), *Bodhivandakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 373), *Raṭṭhapālattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 20), and *Ekañjalikattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 31) [DharmaNexus].
